spans.s:
उडु fn. (-डुः-डु) A lunar mansion or constellation in the moon's path.
 n.
(डु) Water.
 E. उत् above, डीङ् to go or fly, डु aff.

उडुप mn. (-पः-पं) A raft or float.
 m. (-पः) The moon.
 E. उडु as above,
and प from पा to preserve, affix ड.

उडूप mn. (-पः-पं) A raft, a float.
 m. (-पः) The moon: see उडुप.

उडुपति m. (-तिः) The moon.
 E. उडु and पति lord.

उडुपथ m. (-थः) The firmament.
 E. उडु a constellation, and पथ a path.

उडुम्बर m. (-रः)
 1. Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata, Rox.)
 2. The
threshold of a house.
 3. A eunuch.
 4. A species of leprosy with
coppery spots.
 5. A kind of worm, supposed to be generated in
the blood, and to produce leprosy.
 n. (-र)
 1.

. A Karṣa,
a measure of two Tolas.
 E. उडु a constellation in the second case, वृ
to screen, and अप् affix; it is also written ऊडुम्बर and उदुम्बर.

उडुम्बरपर्णी f. (-र्णी) The name of a plant: see दन्ती.
 E. उडुम्बर and पर्ण a
leaf: whose leaves are of the color of copper.
